summary: Frontend-only smoke + UI test of Precise Industries Manufacturing ERP. All 23 nav modules render title/toolbar/table/pagination correctly. Dashboard shows greeting 'Good morning, Arjun' + all 8 KPI cards. Brand is 'PRECISE INDUSTRIES' (no ForgeFlow references). Company selector, notifications, profile, theme toggle, global search + result nav, sidebar collapse, and mobile drawer all work. No console errors detected across full navigation.

issues: Text renders as 'PIPrecise Industries' - avatar 'PI' visually attaches to company name without spacing in DOM text (visual rendering appears fine but selector innerText concatenates). Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is minified into a few very long lines (~ hundreds of chars per line). While it's a small file, readability/maintainability is poor - consider splitting Dashboard, ModuleView, Sidebar into separate modules.
moduleData 'tools' key exists but there is no 'tools-*' rendering distinction; not a bug, just noting.
No error boundary around <App/> - a runtime error would blank the page.
seed_data_creation: None - all mock data in App.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app, no backend. All data static in /app/frontend/src/App.js. Data-testids follow patterns: nav-<id>, <module-id>-table, <module-id>-search, <module-id>-filter, <module-id>-columns, <module-id>-row-<i>, kpi-<label-slug>, plus company-selector, user-profile, notifications-button, theme-toggle, global-search, search-result-<id>, sidebar-collapse, mobile-menu-button, mobile-close-sidebar. Everything working; iteration 2 gaps (company selector + profile toasts) are fixed.
